subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack be narrowed to the QA Lab Matrix migration, or may it also establish Matrix-specific generic SDK calls and change production restart admission for every channel?
rationale: Repository policy requires generic core/SDK seams and explicit owner review for broad production behavior; tests cannot decide whether these wider ownership and runtime changes are intentional product architecture.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Keep Matrix entrypoints plugin-owned and split the global Gateway restart-admission change into a separately reviewed and proven PR.

options.title: Approve the broader boundary
options.body: Explicitly accept the new SDK and Gateway contracts, add sibling-channel reload proof, document the compatibility intent, and authorize the dependency graph for the final head.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this migration if its remaining value does not justify broadening the generic SDK and production restart surfaces.

recommendation.title: Narrow the migration
recommendation.body: Keep Matrix entrypoints plugin-owned and split the global Gateway restart-admission change into a separately reviewed and proven PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged prerequisite and current stack history, making them the best available coordinator for narrowing the branch or obtaining the required adjacent-owner approvals.
